title: myroxylon flexuosum
intro: Myroxylon flexuosum, commonly known as Palo santo, is a tropical tree native to South America. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, offering numerous health benefits, including antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Palo santo include its ability to act as an expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Palo santo include limonene, beta-pinene, and myroxiron, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
